item.title: The view from the proving grounds for next-generation nuclear reactors, Atomic City, Idaho
item.description: A new generation of small nuclear reactors is poised to come online in the next few years. Public opinion remains split.

item.title: Crews battle wildfires in western U.S. and Canada
item.description: There have been 183 new wildfires, including eight large ones, across the U.S. since Saturday, the National Interagency Fire Center reported on Sunday.

item.title: Nearly 30 years after Tupac's death, the trial over his murder will finally begin
item.description: In 2023, police charged Duane Davis, also known as "Keefe D," with organizing Tupac Shakur's murder in 1996. Author Ben Westhoff discusses Davis' trial that begins Monday.

item.title: 'Not a drop': Anger grows as Puerto Rico begins rationing water
item.description: Puerto Rico's government began cutting water service to people's homes this week, amid a severe drought that's exposing major weaknesses in the island's water delivery infrastructure.

item.title: National Guard deployment in D.C. approaches one year
item.description: President Trump's deployment of the National Guard will hit the one year mark next week. The presence of armed, uniformed troops on the street has become increasingly normalized in the capital.

item.description: A longtime Philadelphia Phillies fan, substitute teacher, Lewis Kalb, got to realize his dream this week of broadcasting one of the team's games.

item.title: Childcare crisis: Soaring infant care costs push Oklahoma families to financial brink
item.description: Childcare costs across the country are soaring. In Oklahoma the cost of infant care has gone up more than a third since 2022, putting working parents in a tight spot.
